Hi Connor —

Thanks for agreeing to help us walk through the CAIQ. We've filled out an initial draft but have a few clarifying questions around telemetry, key management, and logs. We'd like a short technical Q&A (30–45m) with your security team plus a brief run-through of how Redwood surfaces evidence for SOC 2.

Possible times (PDT):
- Tue 11 May, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 12 May, 13:00–13:45
- Thu 13 May, 09:30–10:15

We prefer CAIQ format but can do SIG if that's easier. Also: can you confirm what sample logs you'd like (time window, artifacts) and whether there is a secure upload link?

Subject: Re: CAIQ / questionnaire Q&A and call scheduling

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the CAIQ. We're happy to run a 45-minute session (30 min Q&A + 15 min next steps). Wed 12 May 13:00 PDT works for our team. I added Marissa (SIG/SOC2 ops) and Ben (logs owner) to align owners.

Proposed run-of-show:
1) 5m intros and objectives
2) 10m high-level platform and where artifacts live (SLA, deployment modes)
3) 20m focused CAIQ questions (telemetry, KMS, data residency)
4) 10m artifacts & log sample discussion + upload instructions
5) 5m action items and next steps

For logs: Ben will coordinate the sample. Typical ask is 24–72 hours of token-level request logs and a matching server-side access log window; with redaction guidance if there is PII. If you can indicate preferred time windows we can confirm feasibility.

Secure upload: we have a controlled evidence portal — I will share a link after we confirm the meeting; it supports S3-compatible transfers and one-time links.

Confirming Wed 12 May, 13:00–13:45 PDT. Please let me know attendees and any constrained windows.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Security Solutions Engineer

Hi Alyssa, Connor —

Quick notes ahead of the call so we can keep Wed tight:
- Artifact owners: SOC2 report excerpts (Marissa), Logging samples & retention policy (Ben).
- Log sample guidance (attached): we prefer JSON-lines request logs + access logs for the same window; 72-hours is ideal for sampling signal. If Sandstone is limited, 24 hours with high-traffic windows ok.
- Redaction: remove full CC numbers / SSNs; keep hashed identifiers if possible. We can accept pseudonymized fields.

Attachments: sandstone_log_sample_instructions.pdf (PDF)

Action items before the call: 
- Alyssa: confirm final attendee list and preferred window for sample logs (reply to thread)
- Sandstone procurement (cc): let us know if you need an NDA or specific sharing agreement before log transfer
- Redwood: we'll prepare CAIQ crosswalk and SOC2 artifact list for Wed's discussion

If Wed 12 May 13:00 PDT is confirmed, I'll prepare a 15-slide one-pager for the 10m platform/artefact section.

—Marissa
